title: 70 days to election: Anambra NDC plans mega rallies for one million votes as Oluwadara Kehinde drives local agenda
summary: With 70 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC Anambra chapter has planned mega rallies and a major town hall to mobilise over one million votes for the Obi/Kwankwaso ticket. Nationally, the party continues transparent engagement. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation focused on youth, agriculture, education, accountability and infrastructure in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the national momentum and the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 71 days to election: NDC slams Tinubu’s fresh $7.7bn loan request as Oluwadara Kehinde advances local agenda
summary: With 71 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC National Presidential Campaign Council criticised President Tinubu’s latest request for a $7.7 billion (approx. ₦10.79 trillion) external loan to finance the 2026 budget deficit, calling it part of a “one week, new loan” pattern and accusing the National Assembly of rubber-stamping borrowings. The party urged Nigerians to use the ballot for accountability and support Peter Obi and Kwankwaso. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the national demand for fiscal responsibility with the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 72 days to election: Share Joga-Iboro ward engagement as Oluwadara Kehinde continues ground mobilisation
summary: With 72 days until 16 January 2027, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues ward-level engagement across Yewa North / Imeko-Afon, including recent work in Joga-Iboro. Nationally, the NDC maintains transparency and Peter Obi’s nationwide push on unity, security, education and productivity. Share the local images and the national vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.
